title: They Kept Him in His Chair

mood.label: Rattled and uneasy
mood.summary: Rattled and uneasy: a global tech rout tripped breakers in Seoul and pushed Tokyo into a bear market, Brent neared $100, and Iran and Ukraine stayed hot. Paraguay's Congress refused its president's resignation. California's 548 commutations and a finished ISS solar upgrade were the real relief.

lines: A president tried to walk away.
They kept him in his chair.
and someone up in orbit, gloved,
Throw the switch, stop the clock,
Three million waiting at a bank
